title: Remove PDF export option and fix Save project action

requirements.summary: Remove PDF export UI elements from ExportTab while preserving CSV export functionality
acceptanceCriteria: The Export tab no longer shows a PDF download button or any PDF-related UI.
CSV export option remains visible and functional.
No console errors related to the removed PDF elements.

file_operations.description: Remove all PDF export UI elements including the PDF download button, description text, and limit indicator. Keep only the CSV export section visible. Remove any imports or references to usePdfExport hook. Ensure the remaining CSV export UI is properly styled and functional without layout shifts from the removal.

requirements.summary: Investigate and fix the Save project action to successfully persist projects to the backend
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the Save button in DashboardHeader successfully calls the backend save endpoint without errors.
A success toast is displayed after a successful save.
An error toast is displayed if the save fails, with a meaningful message.
The saved project can be subsequently loaded via the Load modal.

file_operations.description: Review and fix the saveProject mutation logic. Ensure the project state is correctly serialized before calling the backend saveProject method. Verify that all required MiningProject fields (id, owner, name, dates, financial parameters) are properly populated. Add error handling to catch and log any serialization or validation issues. Ensure the mutation onSuccess callback shows a success toast and onError shows an error toast with the error message.

Inspect the saveProject mutation implementation. Verify the actor.saveProject call is correctly awaiting the backend response. Ensure proper error propagation from the backend to the UI. Add detailed error logging to identify why saves might fail (e.g., missing fields, type mismatches, backend errors). Confirm the mutation properly invalidates the projects query cache on success to reflect the saved project in the Load modal.

Review the Save button click handler to ensure it correctly triggers the saveProject mutation from ProjectContext. Verify the button shows appropriate loading state during save operations. Ensure any pre-save validation (e.g., checking if a project name exists) is in place. Add error boundary handling if the save operation throws synchronously.
